fields.title: ARMP Cameroon publication record
fields.description: One record per row (mode=list) or per requested publication (mode=detail). A single _error record is emitted instead of payload fields when a page/publication fails or doesn't exist. mode=detail records have either a 'sections'/'sectionList' pair (structured shape, e.g. AO/DC/AMI notices) or a 'bodyText' field (free-form shape, e.g. DEC-ATTR/COMM/ADDITIF award decisions and communiques) -- never both, see CRAWLING_METHOD.md.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: For list records: 'list:<listType>'. For detail records: 'TYPE:ID' of the publication that was requested.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: S1-listing, S1-detail-structured, S1-detail-freeform, or 'none' on error.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed records (blocked_or_transient, not_found_or_restricted).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

listType.title: List type
listType.description: mode=list only -- which listing this row came from (latest, national, international, quotation, proposal, expression_of_interest, restricted, agreement).

_page.title: Page
_page.description: Which page of the listing (10 rows/page) this row came from. mode=list only.

_totalAvailable.title: Total available
_totalAvailable.description: Exact total record count ARMP reports for this category (read live from its own sidebar badge), before any maxResults truncation. mode=list only; null for listType=latest, which has no single matching category badge.

_lastPageSeen.title: Last page seen
_lastPageSeen.description: mode=list only. The highest page number visible in this response's own pagination nav -- a floor on total pages, not a firm total (Laravel's paginator only renders a window of nearby pages plus first/last).

typePublication.title: Publication type code
typePublication.description: ARMP's own internal document-type code, e.g. AO (tender notice), DC (request for quotation), AMI (expression of interest), DEC-ATTR (award decision), COMM (award communique), ADDITIF (addendum).

idPublication.title: Publication ID
idPublication.description: ARMP's own internal numeric publication ID.

title.title: Title
title.description: The publication's full title/header text as shown by ARMP.

procuringEntity.title: Procuring entity
procuringEntity.description: The government body (Maitre d'Ouvrage/Autorite Contractante) running this procurement.

type.title: Procurement category
type.description: mode=list only -- e.g. 'Appels d'Offres National', 'Appels d'Offres International', 'Gre a Gre'.

region.title: Region
region.description: mode=list only -- Cameroonian region, or 'SERVICES CENTRAUX' for national-level bodies.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: mode=list only -- raw estimated/awarded amount text as shown by ARMP, usually in FCFA. Null when ARMP itself doesn't show one.

publishedAt.title: Published at
publishedAt.description: mode=list only -- raw publication timestamp text (ARMP's own format, dd-mm-yyyy HH:MM:SS).

closingDate.title: Closing date
closingDate.description: mode=list only -- bid submission closing date. Null when ARMP itself doesn't display one for this record (e.g. award decisions/communiques have no closing date).

closingTime.title: Closing time
closingTime.description: mode=list only -- companion to closingDate, same null convention.

noticePdfUrl.title: Notice PDF URL
noticePdfUrl.description: Link to download the original publication document from ARMP's pridesoft.armp.cm file server.

daoPdfUrl.title: Bidding document (DAO) URL
daoPdfUrl.description: Link to download the full bidding document, when ARMP has published one for this record (often absent for award decisions/communiques).

detailsUrl.title: Details URL
detailsUrl.description: Link to this publication's full detail page on armp.cm -- feed into a mode=detail run (as 'TYPE:ID' or this URL) for the full text.

sourceFinancement.title: Funding source
sourceFinancement.description: mode=detail only -- e.g. 'BUDGET INVESTISSEMENT PUBLIC(BIP)'. Null when ARMP doesn't show one for this publication.

sections.title: Sections (by key)
sections.description: mode=detail, structured shape only (AO/DC/AMI-type notices) -- every numbered section ARMP itself publishes (Objet, Consistance des Prestations, Cout Previsionnel, Financement, Remises des Offres, etc.), keyed by a slug of its own label. The exact section set varies by procurement type.

sectionList.title: Sections (ordered list)
sectionList.description: Same content as 'sections', kept in ARMP's own numbered order as {number, label, text} -- use this when order matters.

bodyText.title: Body text
bodyText.description: mode=detail, free-form shape only (DEC-ATTR/COMM/ADDITIF-type award decisions, communiques, addenda) -- the full publication text, since these are pasted from Word with no numbered-section structure to key off of.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across all record types -- rows missing a given column render blank.
